name: RedECX
description: A short promotional video created for the company RedECX located in Ecuador. With the help of this video, RedECX has been able to reach a wider audience and generate more leads through social media platforms.

name: Tipsi Calculator
description: Introducing Tipsi Calculator, an app that helps you calculate the appropriate tip amount for any country and divide it among your party, developed by Nyanku. The app has a user-friendly interface and it makes it easy for you to be a savvy and gracious tipper. The promotional video showcases the app's features and ease of use. Available for both Android and iOS.

name: Loveli Love Calculator
description: Introducing Loveli Love Calculator, a fun and interactive app developed by Nyanku, which predicts the compatibility between you and your partner based on your names. Simply type in your name and your partner's name and let the app do the rest. The promotional video showcases how easy and fun it is to use. Available for both Android and iOS.

name: Bambu Bar
description: Introducing Bambu Bar, a classic bar and restaurant located in Quito, Ecuador with 35 years of tradition, featuring Ecuadorian and international cuisine, Gastropub and Live Music. This promotional video showcases the vibrant atmosphere, and highlights their delicious food and drinks. Perfectly crafted for sharing on their social media.

name: Hostal Varadero 3
description: Introducing Hostal Varadero 3, a charming and comfortable hotel located in Quito, Ecuador. This promotional video captures the welcoming atmosphere and warm hospitality of the hotel, showcasing its comfortable rooms, modern amenities, and convenient location. Perfectly crafted for sharing on their social media.

name: La Marelle
description: Introducing La Marelle, a fun and family-friendly French restaurant that offers a unique dining experience. The promotional video showcases the restaurant's delicious cuisine, games, parties for infants, theater, circus, and puppets performances that make La Marelle stand out from the rest. Perfectly crafted for sharing on their social media

name: Las Brochetas de David
description: A promotional video was designed to showcase the mouth-watering BBQ offerings of Las Brochetas de David, a BBQ restaurant located in Ecuador. The video was designed to highlight the restaurant's unique menu items and atmosphere, and to help attract more customers through their social media.

name: Los Pollazos del Manaba
description: A promotional video was created to showcase the delicious offerings of Los Pollazos del Manaba, a chicken restaurant. This video was designed to highlight the restaurant's unique menu items and atmosphere, and to help attract more customers through their social media.

name: Better Home Products
description: A promotional video for Better Home Products, an online furniture store, was designed to showcase their products and services. The video was designed to highlight the unique features of the store, and to help attract more customers. As a bonus, I also had the opportunity to design a brand new logo for the store's website to give a fresh and professional look. The video and logo were designed to work together to give a cohesive and effective representation of the store's brand.

name: Giorgio Intro Animation
description: 'Giorgio by Moroder' from Daft Punk's 'Random Access Memories' album comes alive with a short animation introduction. Created using Adobe After Effects and Clip Studio Paint EX, this animation showcases my animation and compositing skills. Please note that this is for educational purposes only and not intended for commercial use as I do not own the audio rights.

name: Rotation
description: 'Rotation' is a short film where I had the opportunity to work as a Cameraman, animating the creature monster scenes and creating visual effects for some scenes. Directed & written by Daniel Bustillos Costales.

name: Balloontopus
description: 'Balloontopus' is a short live-action and 3D animation film that tells the story of a boy who creates a 'Balloon Octopus' through his imagination. The film follows the journey of the Balloontopus as it is brought to life and takes flight, only to come crashing down due to a confrontation with a plane shark. This project showcases my techincal skills as 3D modeler and animator using Autodesk Maya, as well as my ability to edit and composite using Premiere.

name: House 1028
description: 'The House 1028' is a short and suspenseful animation film based on an Ecuadorian legend from Quito. The story follows a young girl named Bella Aurora who is trapped in a recurring nightmare where she is hunted by a (ghost-like) dark blue bull. Despite her efforts to escape, she is unable to wake up from the dream and is continuously stalked by the bull. The film, with its eerie and terrifying atmosphere, is sure to keep the audience on the edge of their seats. This animation was created in Blender 3D, composite in After Effects. A thesis project for La Universidad de las Americas. This project was worked with Lenin Ortiz and myself.
